data.body: Phase-2 proof before push. Restored held-out tests/unit/test_build_provenance_fixture_scale.py plus tests/unit/test_artifact_probe_workflow.py; 3/3 GREEN against the held-out fixer output. Defect-seeded mutations each returned RED for the intended contract: whole-checkout materialization produced 3,019 tracked paths instead of exactly hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, src/rebar/__init__.py; restoring GITHUB_SHA plus truthiness-only artifact probes failed both workflow oracles; deleting preserve-existing precedence made the real install-from-sdist wheel bake None instead of abc1234. Each mutation was restored, then 38 focused tests passed. Exact six-build serial replay is 9.11s versus the recorded 18.23s baseline (50.0% lower elapsed). Xdist showed host variation (one 16.22s replay, one 9.37s pytest replay); decisive per-worker fixture setup fell to 2.20-2.88s from 6.60-6.74s (56-67% lower). Workflow consumers passed 250 tests; make lint and make typecheck passed. After fast-forwarding unrelated origin/main 0551f5aa8a, the exact macOS-style default tier passed 13,449 / 17 skipped and integration passed 167 / 2 skipped, with unchanged selectors/workers/timeouts. String sweep found no git-archive/tar materializer in the hook-semantics tests; git diff --check is clean. Signed plan review PASS fingerprint c870fe547933696e remains certified on the updated base.
